note: Traditional English proverbs, in the public domain, in a common wording.
lines: The early bird catches the worm.
A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
Actions speak louder than words.
All that glitters is not gold.
A penny saved is a penny earned.
Better late than never.
Birds of a feather flock together.
Don't put all your eggs in one basket.
Every cloud has a silver lining.
Too many cooks spoil the broth.
Many hands make light work.
Look before you leap.
Haste makes waste.
A stitch in time saves nine.
Where there's smoke there's fire.
Still waters run deep.
The pen is mightier than the sword.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
Rome wasn't built in a day.
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
Beggars can't be choosers.
Don't bite the hand that feeds you.
Don't judge a book by its cover.
Easy come, easy go.
Fortune favors the bold.
Honesty is the best policy.
If it ain't broke, don't fix it.
It takes two to tango.
Laughter is the best medicine.
Let sleeping dogs lie.
Practice makes perfect.
The grass is always greener on the other side.
There's no place like home.
Time is money.
Two heads are better than one.
When the cat's away, the mice will play.
You can't have your cake and eat it too.
You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make it drink.
A watched pot never boils.
Absence makes the heart grow fonder.
Curiosity killed the cat.
Don't cry over spilled milk.
Every dog has its day.
Good things come to those who wait.
Great minds think alike.
Ignorance is bliss.
Knowledge is power.
Necessity is the mother of invention.
No pain, no gain.
Old habits die hard.
Out of sight, out of mind.
Slow and steady wins the race.
The squeaky wheel gets the grease.
There's no such thing as a free lunch.
Waste not, want not.
What goes around comes around.
You reap what you sow.
A chain is only as strong as its weakest link.
A fool and his money are soon parted.
A friend in need is a friend indeed.
A leopard can't change its spots.
A picture is worth a thousand words.
A rolling stone gathers no moss.
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
Blood is thicker than water.
Cleanliness is next to godliness.
Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
Don't throw the baby out with the bathwater.
Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
Familiarity breeds contempt.
Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
Give credit where credit is due.
He who hesitates is lost.
He who laughs last laughs best.
If you can't beat them, join them.
It's no use crying over spilt milk.
Kill two birds with one stone.
Let bygones be bygones.
Make hay while the sun shines.
Misery loves company.
Money doesn't grow on trees.
Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today.
No news is good news.
Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
One man's trash is another man's treasure.
People who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones.
Silence is golden.
Strike while the iron is hot.
The apple doesn't fall far from the tree.
The best things in life are free.
The bigger they are, the harder they fall.
The customer is always right.
The devil is in the details.
The road to hell is paved with good intentions.
There's more than one way to skin a cat.
Tomorrow is another day.
Variety is the spice of life.
What's done is done.
Where there's a will there's a way.
You can't teach an old dog new tricks.
You can't judge a man until you've walked a mile in his shoes.
All good things must come to an end.
All's well that ends well.
An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
Appearances can be deceptive.
Better safe than sorry.
Brevity is the soul of wit.
Charity begins at home.
Clothes make the man.
Crime doesn't pay.
Don't bite off more than you can chew.
Don't burn your bridges.
Don't make a mountain out of a molehill.
Every rose has its thorn.
First come, first served.
Forgive and forget.
Half a loaf is better than none.
Hope for the best, prepare for the worst.
If the shoe fits, wear it.
It's better to give than to receive.
Jack of all trades, master of none.
Keep your friends close and your enemies closer.
Lightning never strikes twice in the same place.
Live and let live.
Love is blind.
Might makes right.
Money talks.
Never judge a man by his coat.
No man is an island.
Once bitten, twice shy.
One good turn deserves another.
Patience is a virtue.
Pride comes before a fall.
Put your money where your mouth is.
Seeing is believing.
Spare the rod and spoil the child.
The proof of the pudding is in the eating.
The more the merrier.
The night is darkest just before the dawn.
There's no smoke without fire.
Those who can, do.
Time and tide wait for no man.
Too much of a good thing.
Truth is stranger than fiction.
Two wrongs don't make a right.
United we stand, divided we fall.
Walls have ears.
Well begun is half done.
What you see is what you get.
When it rains, it pours.
You are what you eat.
You can't make an omelet without breaking eggs.
You can't please everyone.
A barking dog never bites.
A drowning man will clutch at a straw.
A house divided against itself cannot stand.
A little knowledge is a dangerous thing.
A man is known by the company he keeps.
A miss is as good as a mile.
A new broom sweeps clean.
A word to the wise is enough.
After a storm comes a calm.
All roads lead to Rome.
As you make your bed, so you must lie in it.
Ask no questions and hear no lies.
Bad news travels fast.
Better the devil you know than the devil you don't.
Big fish in a small pond.
Business before pleasure.
Constant dropping wears away the stone.
Desperate times call for desperate measures.
Dead men tell no tales.
Do as I say, not as I do.
Don't change horses in midstream.
Don't cross the bridge till you come to it.
Empty vessels make the most noise.
Every man has his price.
Every little bit helps.
Fair exchange is no robbery.
Faint heart never won fair lady.
Fight fire with fire.
Finders keepers, losers weepers.
Go the extra mile.
Great oaks from little acorns grow.
He who pays the piper calls the tune.
Home is where the heart is.
If you want something done right, do it yourself.
In for a penny, in for a pound.
It never rains but it pours.
It's an ill wind that blows nobody any good.
Least said, soonest mended.
Little strokes fell great oaks.
Make the best of a bad job.
Many a true word is spoken in jest.
More haste, less speed.
Never say never.
Nothing is certain but death and taxes.
Penny wise, pound foolish.
